description.en:
Gives a player on the pitch a skill effect directly, without a move or a Fighting Spirit. The effect is written into the first free of the player's three effect slots, with value 0. Those slots are what CMND_BTL_GET_SKILL_EFFECTIVE and CMND_BTL_GET_PLY_SKILL_EFFECTIVE check (for example SKILL_EFF_IGNORE_EFFECTIVE = 22 in ie4_soccer_sys.nut).
Nothing happens if the player is not found or all three slots are taken. There is no way to remove the effect from a script.
The optional fourth argument is stored in a 16-bit field of the slot; effects added by moves and Fighting Spirits store -1 there. Its use was not traced.
No shipped script calls it.
Team of the player: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team.
Effect type to add, e.g. 22 (SKILL_EFF_IGNORE_EFFECTIVE) or 14 (SKILL_EFF_PLUS_CRITICAL).
Stored in the slot's 16-bit field; use not traced.
Always null (also when fewer than 3 arguments are given).

examples.case: Letting a player ignore element advantage (not found in script_clean/; invented)
